label: Parent Companies (Global Enterprises)
rule_text: Counts distinct multinational corporations having one or more captive capability centres in India, regardless of how many domestic legal entities or campus locations they operate.
includes: Wholly owned captive tech and operations centres
R&D centres owned by foreign parent companies
Global business service (GBS) units of multinational corporations
excludes: Third-party IT services and BPO vendors (e.g. TCS, Infosys, Wipro)
Domestic Indian enterprises without foreign parentage
Multiple subsidiary entities under the same ultimate global parent

label: Legal Entities (RoC / CIN Registrations)
rule_text: Counts distinct legal corporate entities incorporated in India under the Companies Act with a unique Corporate Identification Number (CIN) or registered as a foreign branch office.
includes: Distinct Indian incorporated private/public limited subsidiaries of multinational parents
Separate legal entities created by the same parent for software, shared services, and IP holding
Branch offices registered with Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)
excludes: Branch campus offices that operate under an existing incorporated company
Representative liaison offices not permitted to conduct commercial operations

label: Operational Centre Units (City Campuses)
rule_text: Counts each physical operational campus, facility, or distinct municipal city footprint established by a GCC entity.
includes: Each dedicated city campus or leased facility exceeding 25,000 sq ft or 100+ seats
Multi-city footprint of the same parent (e.g. Bengaluru campus + Hyderabad campus = 2 units)
Co-located specialized labs (e.g. AI lab, automotive test track) operated as distinct centres
excludes: Temporary serviced-office hot desks or co-working day passes
